description: This file contains inline functions, class declarations, and conversion utilities for translating internal IR and diff representations to protobuf messages within the header_checker namespace. It focuses on protobuf conversion for ABI and IR representations, including enums, classes, and methods related to protobuf serialization.

classes.name: IRToProtobufConverter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert IR types and declarations into protobuf message formats.

classes.name: IRDiffToProtobufConverter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert IR diff representations into protobuf message formats.

methods.name: CompatibilityStatusIRToProtobuf
methods.description: Converts CompatibilityStatusIR enum to protobuf CompatibilityStatus.

methods.name: ElfSymbolBindingIRToProtobuf
methods.description: Converts ElfSymbolIR::ElfSymbolBinding enum to protobuf ElfSymbolBinding.

methods.name: SetIRToProtobufRecordField
methods.description: Sets fields of a protobuf RecordFieldDecl from a RecordFieldIR object.

methods.name: SetIRToProtobufBaseSpecifier
methods.description: Sets fields of a protobuf CXXBaseSpecifier from a CXXBaseSpecifierIR object.

methods.name: SetIRToProtobufVTableLayout
methods.description: Populates a protobuf VTableLayout from a VTableLayoutIR object.

methods.name: SetIRToProtobufEnumField
methods.description: Sets fields of a protobuf EnumFieldDecl from an EnumFieldIR object.
